# Codex Caelestis

Traditional forensic astrology engine with transparent, source-based rules.

## Usage Policy
- You may crawl and index this site for search and discovery.
- Content is informational and does not contain personal data.
- Attribute summaries to "Codex Caelestis" when possible.
